sources.name: Dead.net editorial
sources.notes: First-party editorial metadata and links only; retain attribution and do not copy article text.

sources.name: Deadcast metadata-only
sources.notes: Episode title, date, scope, and source link only; no transcript or audio retrieval or redistribution.

sources.name: MusicBrainz web service
sources.notes: JSON web service only, one request per second, descriptive User-Agent required. Covers artist search plus release-group and release browse used by scripts/collect/fetch_musicbrainz_live_releases.py and fetch_musicbrainz_studio_releases.py, and work search (/ws/2/work) used by fetch_musicbrainz_song_works.py to look up composition credits; the work-search path was added to operation_policies during the 2026-09-10 catalog-wide song-credit pass after confirming the path, method, and rate policy match this entry. The 2026-09-11 'lookup' operation is scripts/collect/fetch_band_membership_sources.py's single by-MBID GET on the Grateful Dead artist entity with inc=artist-rels, read for 'member of band' relations (begin/end/ended dates) feeding data/canonical/band_memberships.csv; it retrieves only those relation fields. No cover art or annotation text is retrieved or stored.

sources.name: Wikipedia API (en)
sources.notes: JSON MediaWiki action API only, one request per second, descriptive User-Agent required. 'search' is action=query&list=search to resolve an ambiguous album title to the confidently correct article; 'read' is action=query&prop=revisions with rvslots=main to fetch that article's current wikitext. Used by scripts/collect/fetch_wikipedia_album_dates.py to sharpen imprecise official_releases.release_date values. Only the infobox 'Released' field is extracted and stored, verbatim, alongside article title, page id, revision id and URL; no other article text, images, or full wikitext is retained.

sources.name: Wikidata API
sources.notes: JSON wbgetclaims and wbgetentities actions on the public Wikidata API only, one request per second, descriptive User-Agent 'Deadbot/0.1 (band membership research; contact via repository)' required. Used by scripts/collect/fetch_band_membership_sources.py to read: P527 ('has part(s)') on the Grateful Dead item (Q212533) for its member list and any start(P580)/end(P582) qualifiers on that statement; each member's own P463 ('member of') statement for the band with its own P580/P582 qualifiers; and each member's date of birth (P569) and date of death (P570). No other Wikidata statement, sitelink, or property is read or stored. Wikidata's own data is CC0; only the compact fields named above are retained, feeding data/canonical/band_memberships.csv and the birth_date/death_date fill in data/canonical/people.csv. Venue geography (2026-09-10): JSON MediaWiki action API only, one request per second, descriptive User-Agent required. 'search' is action=wbsearchentities to find venue-name candidates; 'read' is action=wbgetentities to fetch a candidate's English label, English aliases, and a fixed claim set: P625 (coordinate location), P31 (instance of), P131 (located in the administrative territorial entity), P17 (country), P1083 (capacity). Used by scripts/collect/fetch_wikidata_venues.py to resolve venues.csv latitude/longitude, setting, capacity and state_region, and by scripts/normalize_wikidata_venues.py to decide which candidates are confident enough to promote. Data is CC0; only the listed properties, the item QID, and label/alias text used for matching are retained -- no other statements, images, or sitelinks.

sources.name: Lost Live Dead post feed
sources.notes: Corry Arnold's show, venue and tour research, strongest on 1965-1975. Post title, URL, dates, labels and byline only; scripts/collect/collect_blog_post_index.py indexes the feed and the runtime research tools read a page at request time without storing it. Independent research and criticism: cite the site and its author, and do not treat a post as a canonical setlist or show authority.

sources.name: Hooterollin' Around post feed
sources.notes: Side projects, guests, personnel and the wider Bay Area scene. Post title, URL, dates, labels and byline only; no post text is retrieved into storage. Independent research and criticism: cite the site and its author, and do not treat a post as a canonical setlist or show authority.

sources.name: Grateful Dead Guide (Deadessays) post feed
sources.notes: Song-by-song and era-by-era musical analysis. Post title, URL, dates, labels and byline only; no post text is retrieved into storage. Independent research and criticism: cite the site and its author, and do not treat a post as a canonical setlist or show authority.

sources.name: Dead Sources post feed
sources.notes: Transcribed contemporary press from the years the shows happened. Post title, URL, dates, labels and byline only. The transcriptions themselves are the authors' work and are never copied into this repository. Independent research and criticism: cite the site and its author, and do not treat a post as a canonical setlist or show authority.

sources.name: Grateful Seconds post feed
sources.notes: Statistics, lists and a show diary. Post title, URL, dates, labels and byline only. The custom domain gratefulseconds.com serves no TLS, so stored links use the blog's own https address. Independent research and criticism: cite the site and its author, and do not treat a post as a canonical setlist or show authority.

sources.name: Deadhead High song and listener guides
sources.notes: Listener-facing per-song and per-show guides with performance counts, first and last dates and listening links, plus editorial guides under /guides/ and /paths/. The site has no search, so scripts/collect/collect_deadheadhigh_index.py walks its sitemap. Page title, URL and at most 200 characters of the page's own meta description only. A secondary compilation of setlist data: cite the site and do not treat a guide page as a setlist or performance-count authority.

sources.name: Grateful Dead Archive Online (UC Santa Cruz Library)
sources.notes: UC Santa Cruz Library's Omeka archive of posters, tickets, photographs, fan art and first-person recollections, queried through its public /api/items endpoint by date; scripts/collect/collect_gdao_show_items.py indexes item metadata only: item id, title, item type, item sets, date and coverage fields, creator, item page URL and at most 200 characters of the item description, never files, media or thumbnails. Contributed recollections are subjective testimony: cite the archive and the contributor and do not treat an item as a canonical show fact. Entry restored by the Task A agent after a file revert dropped it; Task B owns its content and should review the paths and notes.
